title: Auth Control Plane invite create request (v1 wire format)
description: Body of an invite create call. The organization comes from the route. email is sent already normalized (lowercase; the server applies the login-key normalization and refuses a value that is not its own fixed point).

schema_version.description: Contract identifier. A reader MUST reject an unrecognised value (G-26: unknown denies).

email.description: Invitee address: lowercase ASCII, a dot-atom local part, a dotted domain with a letter-only top label. A strict subset of the addresses the login-key normalizer keeps unchanged; the server still normalizes and refuses a value that is not its own fixed point.

role.description: An organization role key of the closed catalog (contracts/auth/v1/vocabulary/roles.v1.json). A platform role, superuser and every other value are refused.

ttl_seconds.description: Lifetime of the invite; the server default applies when absent.
